card.description:
W.H. Braum Inc. in Tuttle Oklahoma is looking to hire an experienced Dairy Manufacturing Plant Manager.
 
 
As a fourth-generation family-owned company, our family has been in the dairy business since the 1930's. We have always maintained a reputation for the highest quality milk and dairy products. Our manufacturing plant supplies quality products to our 332 Ice Cream and Dairy Stores in Oklahoma, Texas, Kansas, Missouri, and Arkansas.
 
 
**This plant makes fluid milk, cultured products:** butter, yogurt, cottage cheese, and dips, ice cream and novelties, sauces for the stores/sandwiches, hot fudge for the stores/sundaes.

**Responsibilities:** 
 

* Must have first-hand Plant Management experience with industrial production processes in a ready-to-eat Dairy Manufacturing Plant.
* Participates in new product developments, formulations, evaluations, and strives to improve existing products.
* Ensures that the appropriate standard operating procedures are developed and maintained in all areas of the dairy plant.
* Plans, schedules, and directs the operation of equipment and facilities to ensure safe and cost-efficient operations.
* Responsible for the successful attainment of production objectives, implementation of policies, and most effective utilization of available resources.
* Responsible for expense control, including shrink, labor and overhead costs.

**Qualifications:** 
 

* An understanding of solid manufacturing practices, HAACP/HARPC, Food Safety Programs, and the PMO are required for this position.
* Must have experience as a Dairy Plant Manager, 5 plus years is preferred

 
 
We are an innovative and progressive company that offers an excellent career opportunity. Salary range will be $175,000 to $225,000 and will be based on experience. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, PTO, and 401K.
 
 
If qualified, please call Brian Warren at (405) 503-4583 or e-mail resume to brian.warren@braums.com. 
 
EOE 
 
2026-1513

card.description:
**Sr Plant Manager**

York, PA

**Come Join Us!**

From apartments in New York to hospitals and stadiums in Dallas, libraries at prestigious universities to creating modern retail experiences, our teams contribute architectural glass and building products to projects that shape the way people live, work, heal, learn, and play. At OBE, the work of our employees truly matters. With over 6,500 employees, we operate more than 80 manufacturing and distribution facilities in five countries. You can see some of our favorite projects
here
.

Start your journey with OBE and help us build the future.

**What You’ll Get to Do**

Graham Architectural Products specializes in solving the industry's toughest challenges through beautiful, functional & energy-efficient window and door systems including casement, hung, sliding & projected windows, entrance doors, security & vandal screens, and window wall systems for demanding commercial & institutional projects.

We're looking for a
**Senior Plant Manager**
to own day-to-day operations across two York-area facilities: a large, highly profitable manufacturing plant and a smaller warehousing facility that also runs CNC & packaging operations. This is a highly custom, engineer-to-order manufacturing environment, different from standard build-to-inventory work, where production runs in close coordination with estimating, project management & customer-facing teams to meet demanding, lead-time-driven commitments.

This role is ideal for a collaborative, results-oriented operator who has already run a plant of significant scale & complexity, leads with lived lean/continuous-improvement discipline rather than certifications alone, and understands that in a custom manufacturing business, every operational decision has a direct & visible impact on the customer.

Key Responsibilities:

* Own full plant operations across both York facilities manufacturing, warehousing, CNC & packaging driving safety, quality, OpEx, production & efficiency
* Lead, mentor & develop managers and supervisors across multiple disciplines, building a winning culture & strong succession bench
* Partner closely with estimating, project management & customer service to ensure production schedules & product standards meet demanding lead times
* Champion daily, hands-on lean/continuous-improvement execution on the shop floor spotting waste & opportunity in real time
* Lead plant optimization & automation transformation initiatives, championing new technology, robotics & control systems to modernize operations
* Drive continuous improvement projects that reduce downtime, improve throughput & increase Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
* Create, recommend & manage capital projects, including automation & equipment upgrades, from business case through implementation
* Partner with engineering & IT to integrate MES/ERP systems, data analytics & real-time reporting into daily plant decision-making
* Build strong working relationships with sales & customers, applying emotional intelligence & clear communication to manage expectations in a custom, deadline-driven environment
* Guide teams through technology-driven & organizational change as the plant modernizes & the business continues to grow

**What We Are Looking For**

We know great candidates come from all kinds of backgrounds. If you don’t check every box below, we’d still love to hear from you.

* Must have a Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of managerial experience in a manufacturing environment, including experience managing more than one discipline or department
* Prior experience as a Plant Manager or in a similar plant leadership role at a facility of comparable size & complexity
* Hands-on management experience with budgeting, quality assurance & equipment troubleshooting
* Demonstrated, day-to-day lean manufacturing execution, comfortable identifying & driving improvement on the shop floor without relying on formal belt certification alone (Green Belt/Black Belt or TPS experience a plus)
* Proven track record leading plant optimization & automation/digital transformation projects, including robotics, PLC/controls & MES/ERP integration
* Experience managing capital projects for automation & equipment upgrades, from business case through implementation
* Strong analytical, data-driven decision-making skills; familiarity with OEE, KPI dashboards & performance analytics
* Experience in a custom, engineer-to-order, or made-to-order manufacturing environment strongly preferred
* Strong customer-relationship orientation & cross-functional communication skills; comfortable partnering with sales, estimating & project management on lead-time-sensitive commitments

**What OBE Offers You**

* Benefits that benefit you – industry competitive
 benefits
 at the lowest cost to the employee
* Work-life balance – PTO and holidays, including floating holidays you can choose
* Compensation that rewards your hard work – A pay-for-performance culture with potential for annual raises and bonuses
* Training – We will equip you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed

OBE Privacy Policy

OBE will not discharge or discriminate against employees or applicants for discussing, disclosing, or inquiring about their own or others' pay.

card.title: Senior Manager Production Operations
card.description:
**About Niron**
Niron Magnetics is commercializing the first new permanent magnetic material in decades—a breakthrough Iron Nitride technology that eliminates rare earths, strengthens supply chains, and drives a more sustainable future. At Niron, we’re not improving what exists—we’re building what’s never existed before. The materials, processes, and standards are being created in real time by our team. We were named one of “America's Top GreenTech Companies” for 2024 and 2025 by TIME Magazine, Fast Company World Changing Ideas wins in 2024, 2025 and winners of the Minneapolis/ St. Paul Business Journal Minnesota Manufacturing Awards in 2025 and 2026.
 
 
As we scale to commercial production, your impact is immediate and visible—on the plant floor, in the lab, and in the products our customers bring to life. We set a high bar because what we’re building will last—and so will the legacy of the people behind it.
 
 
**About The Role**
The Sr. Manager, Production Operations leads Niron's production organization through the transition from pilot-scale operations to commercial manufacturing. This leader owns safe, reliable, and disciplined execution across production while building the operating systems, leadership capability, and organizational foundation required for future growth. Working closely with Commercial, Product and Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, EH&S, and Product Development, this role translates customer needs into executable production plans, delivers commitments in specification and on schedule, and drives operational excellence, workforce development, and continuous improvement across the manufacturing organization.
 
 
**What You'll Do**

* Lead day-to-day pilot plant operations and execution of Niron's production plan, delivering customer and internal requests in specification and on schedule.
* Drive production performance across safety, quality, yield, throughput, delivery, and cost by establishing clear operating cadences, visual management systems, and performance metrics.
* Improve manufacturing performance, including safety, schedule attainment, labor productivity, capacity utilization, inventory accuracy, overall equipment effectiveness, yield, and customer delivery.
* Partner with Commercial and Product Management to understand customer needs, product requirements, priorities, and commitments, and translate them into clear specifications and executable production plans.
* Lead the Product Engineering capability within Operations, ensuring production-intent designs, specifications, quality criteria, fixtures, work instructions, and build-readiness requirements are defined and transferred effectively to the plant floor.
* Partner with Industrial Engineering on production planning, capacity analysis, staffing models, line balance, scheduling, and constraint removal to support predictable output and future scale.
* Coordinate with Product Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing Engineering to develop fixtures, establish process and acceptance criteria, and plan and execute customer and internal builds.
* Build robust production planning and control systems, processes, and operating discipline to close capability gaps and consistently achieve output, inventory, and delivery targets.
* Translate business requirements and production priorities into clear daily and weekly operating plans so plant-floor teams understand priorities, constraints, and performance expectations.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Central Operations, including Quality, Supply Chain, and EH&S, to ensure production is safe, compliant, in specification, and on schedule.
* Manage logistics and distribution interfaces to ensure material flow and reliable product delivery as Niron scales.
* Provide production input into capacity planning, capital prioritization, staffing plans, product and manufacturing strategy, and plant scale-up decisions based on demonstrated performance and constraints.
* Build a strong, sustainable production organization by developing production leaders, engineers, technicians, and operators; establishing clear roles and standard work; and reinforcing Niron's culture and values on the plant floor.
* Create a culture of continuous improvement, disciplined problem solving, accountability, and learning across production operations.

****You might be a great fit if you have****

* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing or production operations experience, including 3+ years in a people-leadership role.
* Demonstrated success leading production in a scaling, high-growth, or technically complex manufacturing environment.
* Track record of consistently achieving production output, quality, capacity, and delivery targets while improving safety and cost performance.
* Experience building production planning and control systems, operating rhythms, standard work, and performance management practices.
* Strong cross-functional leadership with the ability to translate customer and product requirements into executable manufacturing plans.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and develop production leaders, engineers, technicians, and operators.
* Comfort operating in an environment where processes, products, and standards are still being defined.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in magnets, metals, advanced materials, powder processing, or another technically complex manufacturing environment.
* Experience launching a new plant, production line, product, or manufacturing process.
* Experience leading or partnering closely with Product Engineering, Industrial Engineering, production planning, logistics, or distribution functions.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or structured continuous improvement experience.
* Experience with manufacturing systems and tools such as ERP/MRP, MES, OEE, visual management, and capacity planning.

**Our Pay And Benefits**

* Salary: $110,000 - $165,000 annually, depending on education, experience and skills
* Equity position in Niron via stock option grant
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Mental healthcare benefits
* 401k plan with 6% company match
* Paid time off to take time for what you need in life
* Experience in a fun, high-performing, manufacturing environment set to change the world

****Recruiters and Employment Agencies:****
Please note that Niron Magnetics does not accept unsolicited resumes from external agencies. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our career site, hiring managers, or employees will be considered the property of Niron Magnetics. Consequently, we reserve the right to hire these candidates at our discretion without any financial obligation to the submitting agency.
 
 
**The following notices apply only to positions involving access to export-controlled technology, technical data, or CUI as determined by the nature of the role and applicable program requirements**
****Export Control / ITAR Notice****
This position may require access to information, technology, or technical data controlled under U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR, 22 C.F.R. Parts 120–130) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR, 15 C.F.R. Parts 730–774), as well as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) as defined under 32 C.F.R. Part 2002. Where such access is required, the Company will evaluate all available license exceptions and exemptions before determining that a formal export authorization is necessary. If an export authorization is required, the Company will determine, based on legitimate business and regulatory considerations alone, whether to pursue one. The Company is not obligated to seek an export authorization in every circumstance, and any decision regarding authorization will never be based on a candidate's citizenship status, immigration status, or national origin. Each candidate's eligibility will be evaluated individually through a consistent, documented review process. The Company complies fully with all applicable federal anti-discrimination laws, including Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 (42 U.S.C.
 
 

* 2000e et seq.), the anti-discrimination provisions of the Immigration and Nationality Act (8 U.S.C.
* 1324b), and Executive Order 11246 as implemented by 41 C.F.R. Part 60. The Company does not discriminate on the basis of national origin, citizenship status, or immigration status in any aspect of employment.

****Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI)****
This role may involve access to Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). Candidates selected for roles involving CUI will be required to comply with all applicable safeguarding and handling requirements, including those under NIST SP 800-171 and any governing contractual obligations.

card.title: Executive Director Operations
card.description:
### **Who We Are**

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a **Human First** philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world's leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML's global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

**About Hudson Rouge**

Hudson Rouge is part of WPP | Ford, the integrated global WPP team bringing together creative, media, production, experience, technology, data, and other specialist capabilities in support of Ford Motor Company and its brands. WPP | Ford connects expertise across WPP agencies and markets to deliver coordinated solutions and a consistent client experience. Hudson Rouge brings its distinct luxury expertise and focus on Lincoln to this broader partnership. As Lincoln advances its luxury ambition and enters an important period of brand evolution, this leader will partner with the CEO of Hudson Rouge and agency senior leadership to assess the current operating environment, identify high-impact opportunities, and build the capabilities and discipline needed to deliver today while modernizing how the agency works for the future.

**The Opportunity**

Hudson Rouge, WPP's luxury boutique and the integrated agency supporting Lincoln, is seeking an Executive Director of Operations & Transformation to help shape the next chapter of the agency and its partnership with the brand. The Executive Director will connect business strategy with people, processes, systems, technology, scope, resources, and financial performance. They will diagnose barriers to effectiveness, introduce fit-for-purpose methodologies, and drive an agency-wide transformation agenda that improves efficiency, collaboration, decision-making, and accountability.

**Leadership profile**

A strategic and pragmatic business operator who is energized by building what comes next. This leader is an integrator and a change agent: collaborative, influential, comfortable with complexity, and able to bring clarity without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. They combine low ego with high accountability and understand the creativity, pace, technology, and standards required to build a modern luxury brand.

Above all, this is a hands-on change leader who can quickly assess how the agency operates, challenge established practices constructively, and identify where changes to processes, systems, organizational capabilities, and ways of working will create meaningful improvements. They bring fresh methodologies, turn opportunities into practical plans, and mobilize leaders across the agency to deliver measurable, lasting change.

As a key member of the Hudson Rouge leadership team, this individual will set a clear transformation roadmap, establish timelines and decision points, and create shared accountability for execution across agency leadership and throughout the organization.

**Key responsibilities**

**Lead the operating model**

* Partner with leadership to evolve the operating model for Hudson Rouge and its partnership with the broader WPPecosystem.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, governance, and leadership operating rhythms.
* Translate business priorities and diagnostic findings into actionable organizational goals, improvement initiatives, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
* Assess and redesign processes, systems, governance, meetings, reporting, and ways of working to eliminate friction and improve quality, speed, and effectiveness.
* Balance the agency's boutique, entrepreneurial culture with the structure required to support a complex, integrated business.

**Reimagine the agency through AI and technology**

* Partner with capability leads to define Hudson Rouge's AI priorities and roadmap, identifying where AI can have the greatest impact on how the agency operates and delivers for Lincoln.
* Translate Hudson Rouge's business, client, and operational needs into clear opportunities and requirements for the central AI team.
* Partner closely with the central AI team, which will lead AI strategy, solution design, governance, and implementation.
* Coordinate adoption across Hudson Rouge, ensuring leaders and teams are prepared to incorporate new AI-enabled ways of working into their day-to-day operations.

**Drive transformation**

* Partner with the CEO of Hudson Rouge and leadership team to diagnose operational gaps, prioritize opportunities, and collectively own a focused, agency-wide transformation agenda.
* Build and manage a sequenced transformation roadmap with clear workstreams, accountable leaders, milestones, timelines, success measures, and regular progress reviews.
* Lead change management from leadership alignment through agency-wide adoption, equipping teams with the tools, communication, and support to sustain new ways of working.
* Track progress and measurable business impact, surface risks and missed commitments, and hold leadership accountable for course correction and delivery.

**Lead Project Management and delivery excellence**

* Provide leadership and direction for Project Management as a core agency discipline.
* Partner with the Head of Project Management to define the PM model, standards, talent expectations, tools, and measures of effectiveness.
* Ensure portfolio visibility supports leadership decisions around priorities, resources, dependencies, timing, and risk.
* Strengthen connections across Project Management, Account, Creative, Strategy, Production, Finance, and specialist capabilities.
* Position Project Management as a strategic business and delivery partner, with the Head of PM accountable for day-to-day PM leadership and execution.

**Integrate business, scope, resources, and performance**

* Connect client priorities, scope, staffing, resources, financial performance, and delivery into a cohesive operating view.
* Establish effective operating reviews around business performance, scope, staffing, investment, and organizational priorities.
* Help leadership evaluate trade-offs involving priorities, resources, timing, and investment.
* Support annual scope and staffing planning by connecting client ambition with the capabilities and capacity required to deliver it.

**Strengthen integration across Hudson Rouge and WPP**

* Build stronger connections across Hudson Rouge and the WPP capabilities supporting Lincoln.
* Establish clear ownership, governance, and ways of working across functions and specialist partners.
* Create greater continuity across strategy, creative, production, media, experience, CRM, analytics, social, PR, retail, and other disciplines.
* Help create an experience in which the client and internal teams operate as one connected Lincoln partnership.

**Experience and capabilities**

The ideal candidate will bring:

* Leadership experience in agency operations, business transformation, consulting, or a similarly complex client-service organization.
* Proven record as a change agent: diagnosing organizational opportunities, redesigning operating models, and leading complex, measurable transformation through implementation and adoption.
* Experience introducing new operating methodologies and translating recommendations into practical roadmaps, timelines, governance, and sustained results.
* A strong point of view on how AI, technology, data, and automation can reshape creative and client-service organizations.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and transformation across functions, locations, or organizational entities.
* Experience leading or partnering closely with strong Project Management or integrated-delivery capabilities.
* Strong understanding of agency economics, scope, staffing, resource planning, and commercial management.
* The ability to connect organizational, operational, financial, technology, and client considerations.
* Strong executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to challenge constructively, align senior stakeholders, and drive accountability across organizational boundaries.
* Excellent facilitation, communication, problem-solving, and decision-framing skills.
* Automotive, luxury, or complex integrated-account experience is preferred.

**Reporting and relationships**

The Executive Director, Operations & Transformation will report to the Head of Hudson Rouge and work closely with the Hudson Rouge leadership team and the WPP | Ford COO and Operations team. Project Management will report into this role, with the Head of Project Management responsible for the PM team, project management standards, portfolio visibility, and delivery discipline.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. card.description:
***Join Immatics and shape*** ***the future*** ***of cancer immunotherapy;*** ***one patient at a time!***

Immatics is committed to making a meaningful impact on the lives of patients with cancer. We are the global leader in precision targeting of **PRAME**, a target expressed in more than 50 cancers. Our cutting-edge science and robust clinical pipeline form the broadest **PRAME** franchise with the most **PRAME** indications and modalities, spanning TCR T-cell therapies and TCR bispecifics.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Innovative Environment:** Help to pioneer advancements in cancer immunotherapy.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Be part of a diverse team dedicated to your professional growth.
* **Global Impact:** Contribute to therapies that make a lasting impact on patients globally.

**Role Overview**

The **Director, Team Lead, Site Operations** is the formal people leader and functional process owner for assigned Site Operations personnel within Clinical Operations. The role is accountable for line management, resource planning, capability development, functional quality, and the design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of designated Site Operations and Clinical Operations processes. The Team Lead enables consistent, compliant execution across Germany and the United States and partners closely with Clinical Operations Leads to ensure appropriately skilled resources are assigned to studies.

**Reports to:** Executive Director, Clinical Operations

**Location:** Remote

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related discipline required.
* 10+ years of experience in Clinical Operations or related functions within biotech or pharmaceutical industries, with 5+ years of that experience in direct people leadership, managing clinical operations professionals

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related discipline
* 5+ years of clinical monitoring experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including roles as a Clinical Research Associate and/or Clinical Trial Manager.
* Demonstrated late phase experience in oncology.
* Experience in cell therapy or other complex investigational therapies strongly preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and global clinical trial requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders across multiple organizational levels.
* Proven experience managing resources, priorities, and competing business demands in a dynamic environment.
* History of driving operational improvements and implementing innovative approaches within Clinical Operations.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections and audit readiness activities.

**In** **this Role You Will:**

People Leadership and Talent Development

* Serve as the formal line manager for assigned Site Operations personnel, including Clinical Trial Associates, Clinical Research Associates and Clinical Trial Managers, and other roles as assigned.
* Recruit, onboard, coach, develop, and retain team members who meet role requirements and contribute to a high-performing, collaborative Clinical Operations culture.
* Set individual objectives, provide regular and meaningful performance feedback, conduct formal performance evaluations, and support career development, succession planning, and promotion readiness.
* Create an environment of trust, accountability, inclusion, and psychological safety while addressing performance or conduct concerns promptly and appropriately.
* Ensure team members maintain the training, qualifications, competencies, and functional knowledge required for their assigned responsibilities.
* Partner with the Clinical Operations Leads (COLs) to ensure study roles, priorities, timelines and deliverables are clear, serving as a point of escalation and receive study-performance feedback on team members.

Resource and Capacity Management

* Maintain visibility of team capacity, capabilities, workload, and development needs; lead resource forecasting and cross-study workload balancing in consultation with the Head of Clinical Operations.
* Assign or reassign Site Operations personnel to studies based on portfolio priorities, required competencies, workload, continuity needs, and development opportunities, in consultation with the relevant Clinical Operations Leads.
* Identify current and future capacity gaps and recommend hiring, contractor support, capability development, or other resource solutions.

Functional Process Ownership and Operational Excellence

card.title: VP of Business Systems and Operations
card.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats. 

 CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com .

 Role Overview

 Build the applications and shared data platform behind the way CHAOS plans and runs the business. You’ll lead a service for Finance, People, and the rest of G&A, connecting core workflows to manufacturing, supply chain, and the commercial systems where the activity happens.

 Your mandate spans applications, integrations, data engineering, and rollout. You’ll own how the shared systems work together in production, with clear responsibilities for IT, Security, Internal Tools, and the teams that own shop-floor systems and data.

 Responsibilities

 
 Own the G&A systems portfolio, roadmap, vendors, and day-to-day service. Agree with business owners on what to build, buy, integrate, or retire.

 Build and run the shared data platform for planning, financial reporting, and operating analytics. Set standards for source ownership, data quality, traceability, and reconciliation.

 Lead integrations across ERP, HR, payroll, and manufacturing systems. Coordinate boundaries with shop-floor system owners and assign responsibility for production issues.

 Own planning tools with Finance. Connect actuals to budgets and forecasts and make the planning cycle usable for operators and functional leaders.

 Lead company-wide timekeeping and other tool rollouts from requirements and vendor selection through testing, launch, training, and adoption. Design project charging and approvals with People, Finance, and program teams.

 Support business systems and data integration for acquisitions. Build and lead a team spanning systems, integrations, and data engineering. Set expectations for releases, service reliability, documentation, and support.

 Partner with IT and Security on access and applicable defense-contractor controls. Report delivery progress, risks, and adoption outcomes to executive leadership.

 
 Minimum Requirements

 
 10+ years in business systems, data engineering, or business operations, including significant leadership responsibility.

 Built a production data platform and integrated ERP, HR, and manufacturing systems in a manufacturing or defense company.

 Led implementations across planning, finance systems, or timekeeping from business design through rollout and support.

 Built multidisciplinary teams and managed vendors or implementation partners. Can explain technical tradeoffs and decisions to executives, engineers, and business users.

 
 Preferred Requirements

 
 Experience using data quality and adoption measures to improve a shared platform after launch.

 Experience in defense, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing, including relevant government-contracting or security requirements.

 
 Why CHAOS? 

 
 Health Benefits: medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

 Additional benefits : 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

 Our Perks: rree daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

 Compensation Components: competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

 Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

 
 
 Salary Range: $300-$350k 



 The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. 

 

 
 Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

card.description:
**About Charge Robotics**
-------------------------

Charge Robotics is a Series A startup building robots that build solar farms.

Demand for new solar projects is booming (one-fifth of all the solar that exists in the US was installed last year!), but today’s construction companies can’t keep up due to limited labor resources.

We thought this was insane, so we developed robots to directly address this bottleneck and speed up the world’s transition to renewables. We’ve shipped our first commercial system already, and are in the process of scaling up our operations to meet our massive demand.

Charge is a fast-moving company, which means constant opportunities for learning and growth. You’ll have a large impact on the direction of our company and our product, which will be reflected in significant equity compensation. And you get to work with giant robots .

If you are excited to work on interesting technical & operational problems with direct climate impact, you’re going to fit right in at Charge Robotics.

Read more about Charge in recent press:

* YouTube - Introducing Sunrise, the assembly line for solar
* Fast Company - Solar Building Robots to Solve One of Climate's Biggest Problems
* MIT News - Making solar projects cheaper and faster with portable factories

We’re MIT-founded and backed by Silicon Valley’s top investors, including Founders Fund, Energy Impact Partners, Lux Capital, YC (S21), and more.

**About the role**
------------------

As Head of Construction Operations, you’ll own how Sunrise gets solar farms built in the field. You’ll run our deployments on utility-scale solar sites end to end, from site readiness and mobilization through daily production to demobilization, and build the team, playbooks and systems that take us from a handful of systems in the field to a fleet.

You’ll report directly to our CEO and work closely with our engineering, manufacturing and commercial teams. You’ll also be the main point of contact for our EPC customers’ field teams.

This is a rare chance to bring deep construction experience to a new way of building solar, and to define what a construction operation built around robots looks like.

**What you'll work on**
-----------------------

* **Run our field deployments.** Own every Charge project from site readiness and mobilization through production and demobilization, and deliver each one on schedule, on budget and to our quality and safety standards.
* **Scale from a few systems to a fleet.** Build the playbooks, staffing plans and field-to-HQ communication protocols that let us run multiple systems across multiple sites at once as our manufacturing ramps.
* **Build and lead the field organization.** Hire, train and lead site superintendents, operators, field engineers, technicians and local crews, and build a culture of ownership, safety, accountability and continuous improvement.
* **Own production performance and cost.** Track install rate, system uptime and cost per MW on every site, find what’s slowing us down, and drive the fixes in the field and back at HQ.
* **Be the voice of the field.** Turn what you learn on site into clear requirements, design feedback and acceptance standards for engineering and manufacturing, so every system arrives ready to build.
* **Lead customer relationships on site.** Serve as the primary point of contact for our customers’ field teams, give regular project updates, and resolve issues before they slow the job.
* **Shape what projects we take on.** Partner with our commercial team to assess site readiness, schedules and labor models for new projects, and bring operational input to pricing and contracts.
* **Own field safety and compliance.** Set and enforce our field safety program, and make sure every site meets OSHA, customer and environmental requirements.

**You bring**
-------------

* **10+ years in construction management, including 5+ in utility-scale solar.** You’ve led field operations on large solar projects, ideally tracker and module installation at an EPC or self-perform contractor.
* **A track record of running multiple sites at once.** You’ve managed several concurrent projects and owned their schedules, budgets and results.
* **Leadership in the field.** You’ve built and led field teams of superintendents, foremen and crews, developed leaders under you, and worked with both union and non-union labor.
* **A strong safety and quality record.** OSHA 30 or equivalent, and a history of safe, high-quality installation on large sites.
* **Command of the numbers.** You’re fluent in spreadsheets, cost tracking, and production reporting. You know how to measure the baseline of a metric so we can track its change over a set period of time.
* **A builder’s mindset.** You’re excited to run a construction operation built around new technology and can quickly turn lessons from the field into better processes for the company. Our HQ team that you'll work closely with is a ~30 person startup, which brings high growth and ownership but requires decisiveness, high operating speed, and comfort with ambiguity.
* **Industry presence.** Strong relationships across EPCs, developers and tracker OEMs, and comfort representing Charge at industry events.
* **Ability to travel 50–75% of the time.** Most travel for this role will be to active solar construction sites all over the US where we deploy Sunrise, with occasional trips to our HQ in San Leandro, CA.
* A degree in construction management, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience leading field work.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* **Tracker installation expertise,** especially on Nextpower (formerly Nextracker) systems.
* **Familiarity with Robotics.** Experience deploying automation, robotics or other first-of-a-kind equipment on construction sites.
* **Startup or scale-up experience.** You’ve built a field operation early on and know when to formalize a process and when to keep moving fast.
* **International projects.** Experience mobilizing equipment and crews for projects outside the US.
* **AI-positive mindset.** You've experimented with creating your own agents and workflows using AI tools/chatbots and are excited about how these could shape and improve the future of our work.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Compensation Range: $220K - $260K

card.title: Director of Offshore Operations
card.description:
**About Endurance**
===================

Endurance is building the world's first modular subsea geothermal power plants, converting vast thermal resources under the ocean into gigawatts of baseload power. Backed by Founders Fund, Felicis, First Round Capital, and Point72 Ventures, our founding team includes veterans from SpaceX, Helion, Blue Origin, and Apple. We have completed multiple deep-ocean deployments to subsea volcanoes and are launching a long-term demonstration project this fall. By leveraging modular design, manufacturing scale, efficient drilling, and latent cooling on the seafloor, we are pioneering a new category of energy that outperforms traditional sources on environmental impact, deployment speed, and cost.

**Responsibilities**

* Own offshore readiness and execution end to end: plan each campaign from mission objectives through vessel, equipment, crew, schedule, and budget, and deliver it safely, on time, and at cost
* Select vessels for each mission: translate mission requirements into vessel requirements for deck space and strength, lifting capacity, station keeping, accommodation, and endurance; evaluate and inspect candidates; make the trade between capability, availability, and cost
* Negotiate and manage charter agreements and offshore service contracts; understand the day rates, liabilities, and terms that drive total campaign cost, and hold vessel owners and contractors to them
* Own marine insurance for our vessels, equipment, and operations; work directly with brokers, underwriters, and marine warranty surveyors, and make sure our engineering and procedures meet their requirements
* Personally perform the design and analysis for equipment mobilizations: deck layouts, seafastening and grillage design, lift plans, vessel stability and motions, and launch and recovery loads; know when independent review or class approval is required and obtain it without losing schedule
* Plan and lead mobilizations and demobilizations: port selection, shipping and customs, installation on deck, function testing, and readiness reviews before the vessel leaves the dock
* Own maintenance and readiness of all offshore assets, including ROVs, drilling systems, launch and recovery equipment, and rigging; establish maintenance programs, spares, and certifications so equipment works when it reaches site
* Define staffing for offshore campaigns and asset maintenance: decide what we hire, contract, and train; establish crew plans, rotations, and competency requirements; recruit and lead the team as it grows
* Lead campaigns offshore as the senior Endurance representative: direct operations with the vessel master and crew, make weather and operability decisions, resolve problems as they occur, and turn each campaign's lessons into better equipment and procedures
* Move aggressively while maintaining exceptional technical rigor and safe operations: set the standard for risk assessments and offshore procedures, surface risks immediately, and drive recovery rather than wait for clean requirements or instructions

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in naval architecture, ocean, mechanical, or structural engineering, or a related engineering discipline
* 10+ years of experience in offshore operations, subsea construction, marine installation, or a comparably demanding offshore environment
* A record of leading offshore campaigns as the person accountable for the outcome, including time at sea directing operations
* Experience personally performing mobilization engineering, such as deck layouts, seafastening design, and lift planning, not only reviewing the work of others
* Direct experience selecting and chartering vessels, including negotiating charter terms with vessel owners and brokers
* Experience owning the maintenance and operational readiness of offshore equipment, with independent responsibility for technical and commercial decisions under uncertainty
* Willingness and ability to spend around two months per year offshore, to travel regularly beyond that to vessels, ports, and suppliers, and to obtain the required offshore medical and safety certifications

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Degree or professional background in naval architecture, with hands-on experience in vessel stability, motions analysis, and structural analysis of deck equipment and foundations
* Experience operating and maintaining work-class ROVs, subsea or seabed drilling systems, and launch and recovery systems
* Experience working with marine warranty surveyors, classification societies, and marine insurers to gain approval for offshore operations
* Experience executing campaigns from remote ports, including international shipping, customs, and local port and agent logistics
* Experience with deepwater operations, heavy subsea lifts, or installation of large equipment on the seafloor

• • A record of building an offshore operations function or team at a small or fast-growing company, including hiring, contracting, and crewing

**Compensation, Benefits, & Perks**
===================================

As a pre-revenue startup, Endurance Energy offers competitive base salaries and generous equity packages for full-time employees. Final base salary will be determined by an array of factors including internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and work experience.

A key aspect of our compensation philosophy is that value creation should be aligned with rewards. Right now this means equity is a significant portion of every full-time employee's compensation. As the company matures, there will be continued evolution and changes to the total rewards and total compensation package. What will always be true is that if we win, we win together. Equity is granted to every full-time employee as a meaningful piece of ownership. We believe the people building the company should share directly in the value they create.

In addition to a competitive base salary and equity, employees will receive all of our other great benefits and perks, including:

* **Benefits**: Health, Dental, and Vision insurance coverage
* **Time Away:** Flexible PTO including 12 paid company holidays
* **Global Fieldwork**: Travel to fascinating deployment sites along oceanic ridges in locations like the Pacific Northwest, Hawaii, Iceland, Japan, New Zealand, and the Azores
* **Hands-on Experience**: Participate in sea trials and deployment operations in partnership with leading oceanographic institutions
* **Cutting-edge Development**: Work with technology that spans high-power electronics, marine systems, and clean energy
* **Impactful Work**: Help solve one of the world's most pressing challenges
* **Dive Certification**: Company-sponsored recreational dive certification
* **Other Perks:** Access to the company boat, free meals and snacks, and the list goes on!

If you’re selected for consideration, a recruiter will be able to discuss in greater detail.

card.description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

The Boeing Test & Evaluation (BT&E) team is currently seeking a **Testbeds Maintenance & Operations Senior Manager** in **Berkeley, Missouri**.

This role will oversee first-line managers of non-represented Maintenance Analysts and represented Flight Operations Mechanics within the Test Operations & Engineering organization in support of Air Dominance, Phantom Works, and Weapons programs.

The Test Operations & Engineering organization supports a wide variety of Lab and Flight testing and collaborates frequently with BDS integrated product teams and production operations. The analysts lead all support activities for aircraft scheduling/certifications/subscriptions, supplier discussions, leasing, and program operations integration. They work directly with mechanics, engineers, technicians, and test teams to support all maintenance and testbed modifications. They also work closely with ramp personnel, flight operations, pilots, safety personnel, airport focals, and the FAA.

The team is growing and looking to add a senior maintenance & operations manager to execute in a dynamic work environment with numerous business partners spread across several programs/tests and multiple sites.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain relationships and partnerships with customers, stakeholders, business partners, peers, and direct reports
* Develop and execute project and process plans
* Implement policies and procedures and set operational goals
* Acquire resources for projects and processes
* Provide oversight and approval of technical approaches, products and processes
* Provide technical management of suppliers and lead process improvements
* Manage, develop, and motivate employees
* Responsibility for the safety and quality of the team’s work, including hazard mitigation, corrective action, and BPSM/RCCA participation
* Oversee Regulatory Compliance and Sustainment programs
* Manage aircraft fleet modifications
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members
* Manage costs and budgetary goals, ensuring performance aligns with plans while proactively identifying risks and opportunities
* Manage the continued airworthiness of Experimental aircraft in accordance with the Federal Aviation Regulations

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* This position requires an active U.S. Secret Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship Required). (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active.)
* Bachelor of Science degree or higher from an accredited course of study
* Experience in Aircraft Maintenance and Aircraft Operations
* Experience leading projects in an aircraft maintenance environment

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Federal Aviation Administration Airframe and Powerplant Certificate
* Test and Evaluation experience
* Experience in Business Aviation Flight and Aircraft Maintenance operations
* Experience in FAA Part 145 Repair Station vendor coordination and oversight
* Experience in experimental or test aircraft modification design and implementation
* Experience managing represented employees
* Experience in Earned Value Management (EVM)
* Experience with BPSM/RCCA processes
* Knowledge of Boeing’s organizational processes, program plans, and policies
* Experience working with business partners for integrated schedules, work instructions and planning, estimating, and cost analyses

US based job, US Person required

**Visa Sponsorship**

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

**Shift**

This position is for 1st shift

Boeing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

 

**Your Benefits**
-----------------

No matter where you are in life, our benefits help prepare you for the present and the future.

* Generous company match to your 401(k).
* Industry-leading tuition assistance program pays your institution directly.
* Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy benefits.
* Up to $10,000 gift match when you support your favorite nonprofit organizations.

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
Eddyfi Technologies offers a diverse portfolio of non-destructive inspection devices such as probes, devices and software for the inspection of critical components in key industries, including the oil, aerospace and nuclear industries. Through its entrepreneurial spirit, its passion for science and technology, and by placing the customer at the heart of our concerns, Eddyfi Technologies operates in more than 110 countries and employs more than 600 people. Eddyfi Technologies currently has 13 centers of excellence and sales offices around the world, all staffed exclusively by non-destructive testing experts.
 
 
This role is part of our ET/UT product line.
 
 
The incumbent of this position plans, directs, organizes and controls the assembly, logistics, planning and supply chain activities of the Central PA sites. This position will lead a team of supervisors and organize the production and communication flow to optimize operational efficiency. In consultation with the planning department, this position determines the strategies to obtain the human and material resources to carry out the annual production plan. Supported by the engineering department to implement strategies to limit the impact of blockers on the execution of the production plan. This position is also responsible for ensuring that the information and technical training of employees at all levels is sufficient and up to date.
 
 
As Director of Operations, you must be able to
 
 

* Create strategic plans for operations to ensure delivery of product on time
* Provide leadership and guidance employees under their supervision.
* Implement and support a management framework allowing fluid and effective communication at all hierarchical levels
* Implement and track the Daily Management System including relevant performance indicators (KPIs) and ensure rigorous monitoring of results.
* Develop time standards, labor ticket entry, and automate the SAP production scheduling
* Setup a production framework to support ISO and QMS standards
* Develop organizational structure and capacity planning to allow for future growth
* Anticipate operational risks and implement mitigation plans to ensure business continuity and supply chain resilience.
* Ensure compliance with quality standards, health and safety regulations, and regulatory requirements
* Optimize production with the strategic plans of cost reduction, improvement of product quality
* Ensure proper training is provided for all team members
* Perform employee performance management through objectives and annual performance reviews
* Participate in the improvement of processes through ERP system optimization (SAP).
* As a change agent, actively support continuous improvement activities.
* Creation and monitoring of departmental budgets
* Oversee and develop production, planning, purchasing, logistics, and customer service functions.

We value transferable skills, different career paths and learning agility. Experience gained through non-traditional routes is welcome.
 
EDUCTION AND EXPERIENCE
 

* College diploma in electronics or other relevant discipline, or equivalent experience
* 8-10 years of assembly or manufacturing experience, including 2-3 years in a management role.

QUALIFICATIONS
 

* Knowledge, understand and applicable uses for operational management methods, including but not limited to Six Sigma, capacity planning and quality control.
* Proven ability to drive results through the use of teams.
* Functional English.
* Customer and customer service oriented.
* Rigorous and organized.
* Ability to coach your resources and support their development.

Be a part of something bigger.
 
At Eddyfi Technologies, we’re proud to push the boundaries of innovation while fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to do their best work. We believe that diverse perspectives, experiences, and ways of thinking strengthen our teams and help us build better solutions for the industries the world depends on.
 
As a world-renowned company, we’re behind some of the most advanced systems in the world—delivering cutting-edge solutions through ET & UT, Remote Monitoring, Nuclear Steam Generators, Automated Vision Systems, and Robotics.
 
Our values
 

* We are customer-centric and put our customers at the heart of everything we do.
* We innovate with a purpose, developing practical and forward-thinking solutions that solve real-world problems and protect what matters most.
* We are reliable and accountable; we do what we say we are going to do. Taking ownership of our actions and delivering high-quality outcomes with integrity, consistency and transparency.
* We are stronger together and committed to creating an inclusive environment where voices are heard, respected and supported.

**Joining our team means:** 

* Collaborating with experts dedicated to innovation in an environment that values different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences.
* Becoming part of an organization that values commitment, initiative, and collaboration to help achieve common goals.
* Working in a growing business that encourages learning, curiosity, and respectful challenge.
* Being supported through fair, transparent and equitable practices.
* Contributing to meaningful projects that create a lasting impact.

We encourage candidates to apply even if they do not meet every requirement listed, as we recognize that skills and experience can be gained in many ways.
 
 
At Eddyfi technologies, diversity, equity and inclusion are fundamental to who we are. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging.
 
 
We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, neurodiversity, or any other characteristic protected by law.
 
 
If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are committed to ensuring an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates.
 
 
All positions based in Quebec require proficiency in French, both written and spoken. Additionally, functional skills in English are required to meet the needs of our offices and clients internationally. For all our offices worldwide, certain positions may be subject to background checks, including credit, criminal, and employment history verification.
 
 
#LI-Hybrid
 
 
Advantages and benefits
 
 

* Flexible working hours
* Generous holiday policy
* Exceptional passion and team spirit

If you are excited to work with some of the biggest brands in the world, in the biggest brand market in the world, come see what we have to offer. a passionate, self-motivated, and detail-oriented team player who is committed to the success of our customers. You will focus on growing and developing existing clients, as well as generating new business by identifying, implementing and executing new strategies.
 
 
**SUMMARY:** 
Leads the day-to-day operations of a large-scale beverage manufacturing facility, with overall accountability for Production, Quality, Maintenance, Shipping, Receiving and Warehousing. Establishes operating priorities and develops leaders and teams to deliver safe, high-quality, cost-effective and efficient production. Applies practical business judgment, disciplined execution and continuous improvement through the Honickman Management Operating System to improve plant performance and support the Company’s business strategy.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 

* Provides visible, hands-on leadership and direction for all plant operations, including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Shipping, Receiving and Warehousing.
* Establishes clear operating priorities, performance expectations and accountability; aligns staffing, resources and production plans with customer and business requirements.
* Ensures production schedules are achieved while meeting safety, food safety, quality, efficiency, cost and customer service expectations.
* Monitors and acts upon key performance indicators, including safety performance, schedule attainment, production efficiency, equipment utilization, downtime, waste, labor productivity, inventory accuracy and service levels.
* Identifies operating constraints and performance gaps; leads root cause analysis, corrective actions and practical solutions that improve throughput, reliability and execution.
* Ensures manufacturing processes, standard operating procedures and controls are documented, consistently followed and improved as business needs evolve.
* Partners with Quality leadership to maintain effective food safety, sanitation, preventive control and quality systems and to resolve customer complaints, audit findings and corrective actions promptly.
* Provides leadership and oversight for preventive and predictive maintenance, work-order execution and equipment reliability; aligns maintenance priorities with production requirements and long-term asset needs.
* Supports capital planning and execution, including equipment upgrades, facility improvements and other investments that improve safety, capacity, reliability or cost performance.
* Oversees warehouse, inventory control, shipping and receiving operations to ensure accurate inventory, efficient material flow, appropriate space utilization and timely customer shipments.

* Comprehensive knowledge of large-scale manufacturing operations, production planning, equipment reliability, quality systems, food safety, warehousing, distribution and inventory controls.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to develop operating plans, manage budgets and labor costs, interpret performance data and translate findings into action.
* Practical knowledge of continuous improvement, root cause analysis, standard work and performance management; ability to implement solutions that deliver measurable operational results.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a complex operation through multiple levels of management and to establish priorities, accountability and disciplined execution across functions.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental and food-manufacturing regulatory requirements and the ability to maintain effective safety, quality and compliance systems.
* Proven ability to lead and develop managers and supervisors, engage a diverse hourly workforce and build effective labor-management relationships in a union environment.
* Excellent judgment, problem-solving, organizational and follow-up skills; able to manage competing priorities and make timely decisions in a fast-paced operation.
* Effective oral, written and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate expectations, performance, risks and recommendations to employees, leaders and senior management.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook; familiarity with manufacturing, maintenance, warehouse and performance-reporting systems.

**EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management or a related field preferred; equivalent manufacturing leadership experience will be considered.
* Minimum 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including prior overall responsibility as a plant, site or operations leader for a large, complex manufacturing facility.
* Prior responsibility for multiple functions, including Production, Quality, Maintenance and Warehouse/Distribution operations, with demonstrated success improving plant performance.
* Beverage manufacturing experience strongly preferred; significant food manufacturing experience will also be considered.
* Experience leading a unionized manufacturing workforce strongly preferred.
* Experience managing operating budgets, labor costs, productivity, equipment reliability, quality, safety and overall plant performance required.
* Any equivalent combination of education, experience and training that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS / WORK ENVIRONMENT / TRAVEL:** 

* Manufacturing, warehouse and office environments; regular presence on the production floor is required.
* Must be able to work around moving equipment, elevated noise levels, temperature variation and other conditions typical of a beverage manufacturing facility, with required personal protective equipment.
* Ability to move throughout the facility and occasionally lift, push or pull up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule and respond to operational needs outside normal business hours; limited travel may be required.

**COMPENSATION RANGE:** 
Potential earning is from $190,000.00 - $215,000.00 annually

Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the company.

card.description:
Nashville Predators Job Description
 
 
**Job Title:** Director, Hockey Systems
 
**Department:** Hockey Operations
 
**Job Reports To:** Assistant to the General Manager
 
**Status:** Exempt
 
 
About the Role
 
The Nashville Predators are seeking a Director of Hockey Systems to lead the data platform and applications supporting our coaching, scouting, and player evaluation staff.
 
 
This position will own the systems that carry hockey data from collection to decision: the pipelines, the data warehouse, and the internal web application staff use every day. This position will also build and lead a team of engineers, set the department's technical standards, and work alongside the Directors of Hockey Analytics and Hockey Research & Development.
 
 
Responsibilities
 

* Own the department's data platform, including ingestion, storage, orchestration, and monitoring.
* Build and maintain pipelines for event, tracking, and league data across the NHL and AHL, along with Junior, College, and European leagues.
* Manage the technical relationship with data vendors, including new feeds and changes to existing ones.
* Lead the design and development of the internal web application that coaches, scouts, and Hockey Operations staff use for player and team information.
* Take models from Research and Development into production.
* Set standards for code quality, testing, documentation, and data quality across the department.
* Own access control and data security for Hockey Operations systems.
* Lead Hockey Operations' use of AI tools in software and application development.
* Hire, lead, and develop the department's engineers, including code review and project assignment.
* Advise Hockey Operations leadership on technology decisions.
* Work with Analytics and Research and Development to set priorities and turn staff requests into a delivery plan.

Minimum Requirements
 

* Minimum of 3-7 years in software or data engineering, including experience leading projects or people.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Advanced SQL and data modeling, including schema design for analytical databases and warehouses.
* Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines in Python, including orchestration, monitoring, and data-quality checks.
* Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with CI/CD, version control, code review, and automated testing.
* Experience building and shipping a web application that people use daily.
* Written and verbal communication skills suited to non-technical audiences and senior decision-makers.
* As a condition of employment, qualified applicant will be subject to a background check, including a criminal history check, driver history and character references.
* Possess a valid driver’s license, possess a suitable driving history and be insurable by the Organization’s insurance carrier.

Preferred Qualifications
 

* Experience with lakehouse architectures and open table formats.
* Experience managing engineers or data scientists.
* Experience with sports event or player tracking data, or high-frequency spatiotemporal data in another field.
* Experience with a modern front-end framework such as React or Vue.
* Experience designing and building APIs (REST, FastAPI, or similar).
* Experience with data visualization libraries such as D3, Recharts, or Plotly.
* Experience with authentication, access control, and data security.
* Experience using AI coding tools to build and ship applications used in production.
* Working knowledge of R.
* Knowledge of hockey and hockey analytics research.

Essential Physical Functions
 

* Ability to sit for extended periods of time.
* Must have high finger dexterity.
* Ability to speak and communicate clearly with others.
* Must be able to occasionally lift and move boxes of office equipment, files, etc. weighing up to 20 lbs.

**Note:** Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Employee will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties as requested by any person authorized to give instruction or assignments.
 
 
**Preds Perks:** In addition to medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, all full-time employees of the Nashville Predators and entities are eligible for Preds Perks. These currently include the following: Competitive pay, referral bonuses, 401K eligibility, priority access to event presales, tickets to events (when available), Nashville Locker Room (pro shop) discount, premium pay for overnight shifts, 19+ days of paid time off each year, Ford Ice Center programming discount, on demand pay, and bonus potential.
 
 
**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Nashville Predators is an equal opportunity employer. The organization does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, or disability status, genetic information, or any other applicable federal or state protected classification. The organization celebrates diversity and is committed to an inclusive environment for all employees.
 
 
In order to ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by the Americans with Disabilities Act, as amended, applicants that require accommodation in the job application process may contact our Recruitment Team at recruiter@teamsmashville.com to request an accommodation.

card.description:
### **Description**

**Schedule**: Exempt, min 40 Hours per week | Monday - Friday | 8am - 4:30pm 
**Department:** Interdisciplinary | Muskegon, Mi
 
 
**What You’ll Do:**

Lead a dedicated interdisciplinary team in delivering high-quality, participant-centered care through the PACE model. You'll coach and mentor team members, collaborate with organizational leaders, and empower participants to achieve their goals while promoting independence, dignity, and overall well-being.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and support a high-performing interdisciplinary team.
* Facilitate IDT meetings and promote collaboration, accountability, and participant-centered decision-making.
* Support onboarding, training, and ongoing team development.
* Monitor team and participant outcomes using data to drive continuous improvement.
* Foster exceptional customer service and a culture aligned with LifeCircles' mission, vision, and values.

**Care Planning & Coordination**

* Guide comprehensive care planning that reflects participant goals, preferences, and needs.
* Partner with interdisciplinary teams, departments, and external providers to ensure coordinated care.
* Oversee implementation of care plans and service delivery.
* Support participant eligibility, enrollment, and care transitions through strong understanding of PACE requirements.
* Identify and address high-risk clinical, behavioral, or operational concerns.

**Operations & Quality**

* Ensure compliance with PACE regulations, organizational standards, and quality initiatives.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including participant outcomes and service utilization.
* Support effective use of the electronic medical record (EMR) and operational processes.
* Lead quality improvement efforts that enhance care delivery, efficiency, and participant experience.
* Participate in audits, surveys, and regulatory reviews.
* *Additional duties may be assigned as needed.*

*The above is a summary of the position, it in no way states or implies that these are the only duties this position will be required to perform. If selected for the position you will receive a full job description.*

 

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 

* Bachelor's degree in a healthcare-related field required; Master's degree preferred.
* Professional licensure (RN, LMSW/LLMSW, RD, PT, OT, or similar) preferred.
* Current CPR certification or willingness to obtain.
* Valid Michigan driver's license and reliable transportation required.

* Minimum of one (1) year of experience working with frail older adults required; three (3) or more years of experience in an interdisciplinary, team-based healthcare setting preferred.
* Leadership or supervisory experience in PACE, managed care, home health, hospice, geriatrics, or a related healthcare environment preferred.
* Experience leading interdisciplinary teams and coordinating participant-centered care.
* Experience with care coordination, service utilization, population health, or quality improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to support operational excellence, process improvement, and change management efforts.

* Knowledge of PACE regulations, CMS requirements, and Medicaid guidelines.
* Strong leadership, coaching, team-building, and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive operational excellence.
* Experience using data and performance metrics to support decision-making.
* Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic health record (EHR) systems.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and influence positive outcomes.

 

### **Benefits**

 

* **Generous 6 weeks of Flexible time off per year**—plus **paid holidays** on top of that.
* **Competitive Benefits for Full-Time Team Members** – Enjoy Medical, Vision & Dental Insurance starting on the 1st of the month after 30 days of hire.
* **Retirement Savings Plan** – Secure your future with employer contributions.
* **Daily Pay** –Instantly transfer your daily earnings.
* **Team Member Referral Bonus Program** – Earn $500 when you bring great people to our team!
* **Career Growth & Development** – Advance your career with tuition assistance and school scholarships up to $3,000 per semester.
* **Wellness Program & Reimbursemen**t – Prioritize your health and well-being, reimbursed 120 a year!
* **Mileage Reimbursement** – Offered for work-related travel.

Offering a full continuum of care, including independent living, assisted living, skilled nursing, rehabilitation, and memory care, Brio provides maintenance-free lifestyles and personalized support to meet residents' evolving needs. With a focus on wellness, connection, and vibrant aging, Brio empowers residents to pursue their interests, build meaningful relationships, and thrive in welcoming communities.
